headline: Kothari Sugars submits NCLT-convened meeting voting results
hook: Unsecured creditors vote on amalgamation plan

modes.bear: Delays or disputes in creditor approvals can stall the merger timeline indefinitely.
modes.bull: Successful creditor approval moves the amalgamation process closer to final NCLT sanction.
modes.simple: The company has shared the results of a meeting where unsecured creditors voted on a proposed merger plan.

summary: Kothari Sugars and Chemicals Limited has submitted the voting results and scrutinizer report from the National Company Law Tribunal convened meeting of its unsecured creditors held on November 13, 2026. The filing pertains to the company's proposed amalgamation and merger scheme. Retail investors should note that the progress of this merger affects the corporate structure and future financials of the listed entity.
whats_next: Next NCLT or exchange updates regarding the merger scheme approval.
why_it_matters: Merger progress updates shape corporate structure for shareholders.
